Pursuant to Section 4 04 of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Administration for Childrens Services intends to renew its human services contracts with the vendors listed below for the continued provision of Homemaker Services. The proposed renewal term for these contracts is January 1, 2027, through December 31, 2029. Vendor names, business addresses, and contract EPINs are provided below.

This notice is for informational purposes only. Anyone who would like to share comments or concerns regarding the providers performance and other factors relevant to the renewals, may contact Keshia Wyllie via email at Keshia.Wyllie@acs.nyc.gov.
